title: Notes in the page: ✎ tab, note pane, autosave, :note
what:
notes/index.js registers:
- the left tab ✎ 'notes'
- the 'note' pane kind
- the command `:note [title]`: a new note, its pane opened at once, from anywhere (the operator's 'quickly make … notes')
It imports the stubs notes/{cards,send,handoff,agentmail}.js.
notes/tab.js:
- `[ + new note ]`; notes newest first (title, age)
- 'received (n)' and 'sent' slots (N2b)
- folded trash with restore and `[ empty… ]` (confirmed)
notes/pane.js:
- the TUI frame with the note name in the top border; a plain textarea
- bottom border: `[ send to node ]` (N2b) `[ rename ]` `[ trash ]` and the save state: 'saved · 2s' | 'saving…' | 'conflict: [ reload ] [ keep mine ]'
notes/store.js:
- autosave 800 ms after the last key, on blur, on pane close and on visibilitychange hidden
- one save in flight; POST with the base sha; 409 means conflict
- a failed save keeps the text in localStorage (try/catch) and shows 'not saved'
The focus state is named 'notepad' (a whereOwner), because app.js:58 already uses 'note'.
tests:
notes.test.mjs:
- the autosave scheduler (debounce, one in flight, the conflict path)
- title derivation
- `:note groceries` creates with that title
live_check:
fake perch on PORT=48134:
- create, type, see saved
- `:note x` from a chat pane opens a new note pane
- two tabs on one note show the conflict UI
- rename; trash and restore
risk: None beyond lost-text paths, which are covered by localStorage.
